input: Find a local martial arts dojo for adults

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Adult Martial Arts Dojo
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable martial arts dojo in the user's local area that offers classes for adults.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location or preferred area to narrow the search geographically.

questions.title: Which martial art style are you interested in?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a preference such as Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, Karate, Judo, Taekwondo, Krav Maga, or is open to any style.

questions.title: What is your primary goal for joining a dojo?
questions.description: Understand the user's motivation, such as self-defense, fitness, competition, stress relief, or learning discipline.

questions.title: What is your current experience level in martial arts?
questions.description: Find out if the user is a complete beginner, has some prior training, or is an experienced practitioner returning to practice.

questions.title: What days and times are you available for classes?
questions.description: Identify scheduling constraints such as weekday evenings only, weekends, or full flexibility to match dojo timetables.

questions.title: What is your monthly budget for membership or classes?
questions.description: Establish a price range the user is comfortable with to filter out dojos that are outside their financial comfort zone.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the dojo?
questions.description: Determine the maximum acceptable commute distance or travel time the user is comfortable with on a regular basis.
